description: Delete a test suite by project code and ID. WARNING: the cases inside, and any child suites, are deleted with it along with their history, and `delete_cases` currently has no effect. Read the tree from qase_project_context and move what matters first. Asks the user for confirmation. Cost: one API call, about 0.4s.

delete_cases.description: Has no effect today: the server sends a field this endpoint does not accept, so the cases are deleted either way. Kept so existing callers do not break.

name: qase_suite_delete
title: Delete suite
